Commentary.Commentary: Such targets are always tricky and with the surface also being tricky, we could be in for a good second half here. Bangladesh will need to bowl well, not like they did last time around. Sri Lanka will know, if they get two good partnerships, the game is more or less in their bag. Will Sri Lanka seal the series here or will Bangladesh make it 1-1? Stay tuned to find out in a while.

Mehedi Hasan who is up for an interview says Mushfiqur was excellent today and he executed his plans really well. Admits that he deserved to get a hundred. Mehedi tells they had lost 4 quick wickets so Mushfiqur just held one end and was looking to bat till the end, which he did. On the pitch, Mehedi says that it is on the slower side and there is spin on offer for the bowlers. Mehedi further adds that he thinks 238 is a good score and he is confident of defending it.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, will be disappointed with how things ended. They had Bangladesh on the mat at 117 for 6 as the pacers ran through the top order. Akila Dananjaya then blew away the middle order. It seemed like Sabbir and Rahim would stitch another important stand but the former was run out. At that time, it looked like Bangladesh would be bundled out for below 150. However, Mehedi Hasan then played the perfect foil to Rahim. The two added 84 and gave some respectability to the score. Rahim's flourish right at the end, saw Bangladesh get to a total they would be pleased with.

An excellent recovery from Bangladesh! An excellent innings from Rahim, one can say, he has dug his team out of a hole all by himself. He is congratulated by the Sri Lankan players as he walks off and due to him, Bangladesh have a competitive total on the board.

Back of a length ball outside off, Mustafizur pulls it wide of fine leg and runs the first one hard. Mushfiqur calls him for the second and Mustafizur responds. The throw at the keeper's end is a poor one as it is wide to the left of Perera. That poor throw allows Mustafizur to get in. BANGLADESH FINISH WITH 238/8 FROM THEIR 50 OVERS.
Short ball, Mushfiqur pulls it but it is towards fine leg meaning he gets just a single. So unless there is a no ball or a wide and they take a run, he won't get his well deserved hundred.

OVERTHROWS! Very poor from Sri Lanka! Good length ball outside off, Mustafizur swings his bat at it but misses. Mushfiqur was half way down to steal a bye. Perera throws this one directly to Nuwan who gathers it and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and the ball rolls towards long off where there is no one to back-up the throw. The fielder there gathers it and the batters take 3 byes in total and this brings Rahim back on strike.
Just a single. Good length ball around off, Mushfiqur just manages to stroke it towards cover and get a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is the new man in.

OUT! Taijul is short of his crease but more importantly for Bangladesh, Mushfiqur is on strike. Short ball outside off, Taijul looks to pull but misses. Perera has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Taijul is guilty of watching his partner. The ball goes to Pradeep and he scores a hit at the bowler's end.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Taijul is the man in question.

DROPPED! Mushfiqur gets a lifeline! Good length ball on middle and off, Rahim moves away and looks to play the paddle. He ends up edging to the left of Perera. Kusal gets his glove to it but cannot take it. Rahim takes a single.

Udana bowls this one on good length and slower again, outside off. Rahim just pushes it towards covers and keeps the strike. Great over for Bangladesh, best of the innings so far. 16 off it and Bangladesh are 230/7 going into the final over.

SIX! Mushfiqur has demolished that! Udana goes for a yorker but ends up serving a high full toss. Rahim is not taken by surprise and whacks it over the backward square leg fence for a biggie. Mushfiqur thinks it should be a no ball but the umpire is happy with it. Rahim and the umpire have a discussion. Anyway, Mushfiqur moves into his 90's now.

FOUR! Innovative but executed brilliantly! Mushfiqur is on fire here and is looking to get to his hundred. Again a slower length ball by Udana outside off, Mushfiqur pre-meditates it, goes down on one knee and paddles the ball over the head of the keeper for a boundary.

FOUR! Brilliant placement! Slower ball, short and outside off by Udana. Mushfiqur picks it up early, goes onto the back foot and plays it over the fielder at cover and in the gap. The ball takes a couple of bounces and it goes into the fence for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off again. Islam reaches at it, plays it towards deep point and gives the strike to Mushfiqur.
Bouncer bowled by Udana. It looked very high but the umpires don't think so. Taijul misses his pull and the ball carries to the keeper.
Outside off, Taijul slams it towards cover and keeps the strike with a single.
In the air but safe. Short ball around off, Mushfiqur pulls it over fine leg. The ball though falls short of fine leg and gets to him on a bounce.

FOUR! Vital runs these for  Bangladesh. Short ball around off, Mushfiqur sees that mid off is up so he just lofts it over mid off with his flat-bat for a boundary. Smart batting this from Little Mush!

Direct hit and that would have been close. Good length ball outside off, Tajiul stretches out and manages to hit towards cover. He takes off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowlers end but misses.
Don't know the logic here. This time he pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and now he takes the single.
Pradeep bangs it in short, Mushfiqur pulls it to deep mid-wicket but does not take the single.
Taijul defends the ball off the front foot to get through the over.
Pushes to cover and takes a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.

Perera misses the ball here. Had he collected it, Mushfiqur would have been a goner. Poor from Perera. Full ball around off, Mushfiqur shuffles across and lofts it wide of fine leg. Rahim wants two and goes for it. The throw from the fine leg fielder is a good one but Perera is casual in his approach and he fails to gather the ball while dislodging the stumps. Mushfiqur puts in a dive but had Perera gathered it his dive would have been in vain.
Play and a miss!
Low full toss, hit over mid off for a couple.
Cut to point.
Full length ball on off, Taijul pushes it to mid off.
Fuller on off, Taijul drives it straight to cover.
Excellent delivery! Comes around the wicket and bowls a yorker on middle and leg, Taijul cannot do much but just jam it out.
Taijul Islam is the new man in.

OUT! End of a very good knock from Mehedi! He will miss out on a well deserved fifty here. Pradeep outfoxes Mehedi with a very nicely bowled slower ball. It is around off, Mehedi looks to go over mid off but does not get the desired timing and elevation on it and he ends up hitting it straight to  the man at mid off. Skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne there makes no mistake and takes a simple catch. Good knock from the youngster though. His partnership with Mushfiqur has taken his side to a fighting total here.
Good length ball outside off, Mehedi late cuts it fine of third man for a couple.
On the pads, Mushfiqur looks to flick but it goes off his thigh pad for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep is reintroduced into the attack.

FOUR! Easy pickings here for Mehedi. Udana bowls a full toss way outside off. Mehedi just hits it over the cover fielder who was inside the circle and the ball goes into the fence. Good over for Bangladesh.
Back of a length ball on off, Hasan plays it off the back foot towards point.
Short of a length on off, Rahim plays this uppishly above the head of the short cover fielder. The sweeper cover fielder gathers it and the batters pick up a single.
Full toss on the off side by Udana, Rahim drives it to the cover fielder.
Drives this full ball towards sweeper cover and takes a single.

Cut away but just short. Length ball on the off side by Udana, Rahim cuts it towards cover point uppishly but it falls just short of the fielder in the deep. He collects the ball and the batters cross for a single.
Isuru Udana is back on!
Good length ball on off, Mehedi strokes it to point. Lahiru Kumara finishes without a wicket. Still he had a good day with the ball. Finishes with the figures of 10-0-42-0.
Close to the off pole, Mehedi defends it towards point.

Appeal from the bowler but the umpire is not interested. Good length ball around off, Mehedi has a poke at it but the ball goes just past the outside edge. Lahiru goes up in a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Once again it is on top of off, Mehedi defends it off the front foot.
Pulls his length back on off, Mehedi defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Full on off, Mehedi flicks it and places it beautifully wide of deep mid-wicket to score a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Mehedi nudges it to long on and keeps the strike. De Silva finishes with the figures of 10-0-39-0.
WIDE! This one pitches outside leg and straightens after pitching. Left by Hasan and wided by the umpire.
Full and tossed up on off, Rahim goes down again on one knee and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single.
Rahim comes down the ground and pushes this full ball back to de Silva. He dives to his right and catches the ball.
Floated around leg, Mushfiqur goes for the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad.
Fuller this time, Mehedi takes a foot forward and sweeps this one down to deep fine leg for another single.
Length ball on the off pole, Rahim flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva is back on.
Dot to finish the over but still a decent over for Bangladesh. The last ball is full on off, Mehedi pushes it to cover.
On top of the stumps, Mushfiqur dabs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Length ball around off, Mehedi flicks it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high. It goes over Mehedi's head. Hasan does not even duck as he knew it was going well over. Wided by the umpire.
Full on off, Mehedi taps it back to the bowler.
Sensible batting this. He follows the boundary with a smart single towards cover.
FOUR! Lovely from Mushfiqur! Kumara bowls it outside off, Rahim waits and then cuts it wide of point beautifully to fetch himself a boundary.
Akila bowls this on the pads, Mehedi plays this one off the front foot towards mid on. Good over by Dananjaya

A huge appeal but not given! This looked like it was plumb but the Lankans have no reviews left. Akila screams his heart out but the umpire is unmoved. Akila floats it on a good length and the ball turns into Mehedi, he tries to sweep the ball but misses. He is struck right in front of the stumps but the umpire might be thinking that this is going down the leg side. Hasan survives and so do Bangladesh.

FOUR! Good shot by Mehedi but this is more like poor fielding by the Lankans. The ball was a bit short, MH goes onto the back foot and plays the ball as late as possible to guide it fine towards third man. Dimuth is there to cut the ball from going to the fence but he is late to get down and the ball just passes through him. Bad example set by the skipper here.
Full on the legs of Mehedi, he blocks it out towards mid on.
On off again, Rahim pushes it towards the off side and takes one.
Flatter and on off, this is guided towards point.
Poweplay 3 has been signaled! A maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Length delivery around off, Mushfiqur runs it down to third man and gets a single.
Good length ball on off, Mehedi punches it towards cover for a single.

FIVE WIDES! That was a very poor ball from Lahiru. He looks to go for a yorker but the ball swings away. It ends up being a full toss wide down the leg side. Perera dives to his left but cannot stop the ball.
On the pads, Mehedi flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Gloved fine! Short ball around the body, Mehedi goes for the pull but gets a glove on it fine down the leg side. The keeper has no chance of stopping that and it goes away to the fence.
Direct hit would have made it close. Full on off, Mushfiqur strokes it towards mid off and gets off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length ball on off, Mehedi glances it square on the leg side for a single.
Lahiru Kumara is back on!
On middle, it is kept out.
Good running! This is on the pads, Rahim works it with soft hands through mid-wicket and takes two.
Worked with the turn to the man at short fine leg.
Flatter on off, this is guided to point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On off, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Akila Dananjaya is back!
Shortish in length, Mehedi flicks it again to mid-wicket. No run.

Good length ball on middle, Mehedi flicks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single but Rahim who responds at first decides to send Mehedi back. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but Hasan is in. Lucky break for MH.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and on the body, Mehedi swivels and pulls it through backward square leg and the ball races away to the fence. Runs starting to come now for the visitors.
Good length ball outside off stump, Mehedi tries to cut but gets an inside edge which goes just past the off stump. Mehedi survives.
Rahim misses out on the free hit. It was a full toss on the pads but can only hit it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Just the single from the Free Hit.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! Free hit for Bangladesh. Much  needed at that. Coming to the ball, it was a good length delivery aimed at middle, Mehedi flicks it to square leg and gives Rahim the strike for the free hit.
Good length ball on off stump, Rahim plays it to third man and takes a single.
Another single to end a productive over for Bangladesh. This is on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Fifty for Rahim! He is fighting a lone battle out there but needs to stay there till the end. Also, he has to hope some other batter hangs around. His 37th in ODIs. He gets there by guiding it through point for one.
Another loopy ball on off, this is hit through covers for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Clever batting. Picked his spot well. Uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball, goes over mid off and bags a welcome boundary.
Floats it up on off, this is hit back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and on middle pole, Mehedi pushes it to mid on and take a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but Hasan was well in.
Full toss on the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it towards square leg and moves to 49 with that single.
Shortish length on the body, Mehedi pulls hard but straight to the fielder. Another single.
Slower delivery on middle stump, Rahim flicks it to square leg and take another single. Rahim moves to 48.
Good running! Short delivery on the body of Mehedi, he rocks back and pushes it to mid on and take off for a quick single.
Good length ball on the fourth stump, Rahim guides it to third man for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep is back!
Outside off and slightly short, Mehedi throws his wicket but misses.

That was not far away from another disaster for Bangladesh. Tossed up on off, Mehedi nudges it to the left of mid on. Mushfiqur calls for a single but Mehedi is a bit late to react. Once Mehedi reacts and comes half way down, Mushfiqur sends him back. The throw though at the keeper's end is a very poor one. Meaning, Mehedi's dive gets him in.
Flighted on middle, Mushfiqur paddles it fine down the leg side for a single.
Floated on middle, Mehedi flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short on off, Mehedi punches it to point.
Floated on middle, Mehedi strokes it to mid on.
Another short one from Udana, Mehedi moves towards the off side and pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Shortish in length on middle stump, Mushfiqur pulls it to square leg and they cross over for a single.
Short delivery on the head of Mehedi, he pulls it towards fine leg where it just falls short of the fine leg fielder.
Good length delivery on off stump, Mehedi plays it to mid off. No run taken.
Good length ball outside off stump, Rahim cuts to deep cover and take a run.

FOUR! Just wide of the keeper! A heart in the mouth moment for Rahim. A slower one on off, it angles away and there is extra bounce too. Rahim looks to guide it down to third man but due to the extra bounce, it goes off the outside edge, just past the diving keeper and into the third man fence.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Mehedi plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Mushfiqur pushes it wide of point for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Mehedi glances it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around off, Mehedi flicks it to square leg.
Shortish in length, Mushfiqur cuts it towards cover for a single.
Loopy delivery on the pads, Rahim flicks to mid-wicket.
Mehedi starts his innings with a good looking cover drive. Full on off, Mehedi drives it off the middle but straight to the fielder at cover.
Mehedi Hasan is the new man in.

DRINKS! Sri Lanka continue to dominating proceedings. They have Bangladesh on the mat here. Just the one more wicket and then they are into the bowlers. The visitors on the other hand, need a partnership and a good one. They need someone to hang in there with Rahim. Can any of the remaining batters do so? We'll have to wait and watch.

OUT! Caught! Brilliantly directed bouncer does the trick here! Udana comes steaming in and bowls a bouncer close to the body. Mosaddek goes for the pull but ends up top edging it to the left of the keeper. Kusal Perera behind the stumps, moves to that side and stretches out to take a very good catch. Bangladesh's struggle to get a partnership going continues.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Now Udana goes full on off, Mosaddek nudges it towards point for a single.
Another short ball, Mosaddek pulls it wide of fine leg for a couple.
Back of a length ball around off, Hossain defends it off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on middle, Hossain drives it towards mid on for another single.
Short on off stump, Mushfiqur defends it off the back foot towards point for a single.
On middle, it is worked through square leg for one.
Short on off stump, Mosaddek guides it to point but no run is available.
Flatter delivery on middle, Mosaddek flicks it to short fine leg for a dot.
Loopy delivery on middle, Rahim flicks it to square leg for a run.
Another slower one on off, MH guides it to point.
Good length ball on the off side, Rahim plays this one towards point and they cross for a single.

BEATEN! Bang on line and length this time. Pitches on length and drifts away from the batter, Rahim tries to defend it but he does so inside the line of the delivery. The keeper, Perera appeals loudly and Udana follows it up, but the umpire shakes his head. Replays roll in and ultra-edge shows no signs of any bat involved.
Udana changes sides but the ball is way too away towards the off side. Wide signalled.
Length ball around the off pole, Mosaddek tries to play at it and gets an outside edge on it. The ball goes towards third man and they take a single.
Bowled on a good length outside off, left alone by Mosaddek.

Isuru bowls this one full and outside off, Mosaddek gets on the front foot and drives it through the cover region. The fielder dives to his left to try and stop it but can not. The fielder in the deep picks it up and the batters cross for two.
Isuru Udana is back!
On off, this is kept out.
This is flatter and on middle, Sabbir works it through mid-wicket for one.
On off and turning away. Sabbir opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for two.
Another loopy ball on off, Mosaddek pushes it to covers.
On off, Sabbir defends it out.
This is on middle, it is worked through square leg for one.
Down the leg side and it has been wided.

Kumara bowls it full and around off, rahim tries to flick it towards the leg side but gets the leading edge. It uppishly goes towards the third man area but there is no fielder there. The batters cross for a single.
Bouncer again but this time Rahim ducks. He is expecting a wide to be signalled by the umpire but to no avail.
Full ball on middle and off, Rahim pushes it back to the bowler. Kumara, in a show of aggression, throws it back towards the keeper's end. The crowd is elated and roars.

NOT OUT! This is fuller on off, Rahim strokes it over the bowler towards mid off and the batters take one. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. The ball rolls towards the keeper who fails to collect it. It goes down towards fine leg for an overthrow. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that the batter is well in.
WIDE! Way outside off, Rahim tries to chase and hit it but misses. Wide signalled.
Again short of a length ball, this time Mosaddek gets on top of it as he guides it towards the third man fielder. The batters take a single.
Length ball on off, Rahim stands tall and pushes this one towards third man and takes a single.
Slightly shorter and on off, Rahim works it through square leg for one.
The googly but it is down the leg side. Wided.
Flighted ball on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
On middle, defended.
Floated it up on off, Mosaddek defends it out.
Flatter and on off, this is guided through point for one.
On off, this is worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
Full length ball on the off side, Mosaddek pushes this one towards the cover fielder.

Another play and miss! this time on a good length on the fourth stump line, Mosaddek tries to push at it but plays inside the line of the delivery. Fortunately for Bangladesh, no bat involved in this one.
Bouncer again. Beaten this time. It was a bit wider this time and Mosaddek tries to guide this one towards point. He misses the ball and it carries through to the keeper.
Short ball on head height just outside off pole, Mosaddek does well to keep it down as he hits it towards short mid -wicket.
Around off, Mushfiqur runs it down to third man for a single.
Beaten! Good length ball outside off, Mushfiqur looks to defend but misses. Mushfiqur needs to keep his calm here, if he departs then most of Bangladesh's hope will drown with him.
Lahiru Kumara is back on!
A dot to end a successful over for Bangladesh. On off, this is kept out.

An appeal but not given! This is the leg spinner. It pitches on off and turns away. Hossain goes back and tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing off.
On off, this is kept out.
Mosaddek Hossain walks out to bat next.

OUT! The wild throw and the dive does not save Sabbir there. That is how far out he came running. Just needless for Bangladesh. This is the last thing they would have wanted. The pair which played so well in the last game hardly contributes anything this time around. Bangladesh have half the side back in the hut and they have not even crossed 100. Dananjaya lands this on off. Sabbir pushes this towards covers and sets off. Rahim takes a few steps ahead but then sends him back. The fielder picks the ball up and the throw is a poor one. The keeper collects the ball and then dives to shatter the stumps. An appeal follows and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that Sabbir's dive has not saved him. Mushfiqur is once again involved in a run out. In the last game it was Mosaddek who fell prey and this time it is Sabbir.
Is Sabbir short? Well, the poor throw might have saved him. The umpire has taken it upstairs.

DROPPED! Tough chance but Akila cannot hold onto it. Floated on middle, Mushfiqur comes down the track and hits it hard but uppishly to the right of Akila. Dananjaya gets his hands to it but cannot hold onto it. In Akila's defense, the ball was hit with power and came to him very quickly allowing Dananjaya very little time to react.
Floated on middle, Mushfiqur flicks it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it towards square leg and takes a quick single. He will keep the strike.
Flighted outside off, Sabbir strokes it towards point for a single.
Floated delivery by de Silva, the batter plays it towards point off the front foot.
Again full and floated on off, Sabbir drives it towards covers again.
Full ball on off, Sabbir drives it towards covers but the fielder dives towards his right and saves runs for his side.
Tossed up on off pole, Sabbir tries to flick it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge as the ball goes towards point. Sabbir sets off for a run and Rahim responds as they complete a single.

FOUR! Poor effort in the deep from Lahiru Kumara. Floated on off, Sabbir gets on one knee and plays a strong sweep. The ball goes to the right of fine leg. Kumara there puts in a dive but the ball goes through him to the fence.
Loopy ball on off, Mushfiqur taps it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Mushfiqur flicks it to the on side and rotates the strike.
On middle and leg, Sabbir glances it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Huge appeal for LBW but Marais Erasmus is unmoved. Leg spinner pitching on middle, Sabbir gets across and looks to flick. He misses and the ball hits him around the pads. Huge appeal from the Sri Lankan players but the umpire says no.
Shorter around off, Mushfiqur flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Full ball on off, Sabbir plays it straight back towards the bowler. De Silva dives to his left but is unable to stop it, however the fielder at mid off cuts it off. Sri Lanka keeping up the pressure here.
Full length ball on middle, Sabbir plays it towards mid on.
Flat and short on off. Rahim goes onto the back foot and punches this one towards cover point.
Tossed up on off, Sabbir glances it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Rahim plays this full one off the front foot towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Off spinner pitching around off, Mushfiqur plays it late and defends it to point.
Dhananjaya de Silva is back into the attack.
Off spinner on off, Sabbir defends it off the front foot to get through the over.
Yorker on off, Sabbir gets his bat down in time.
Floated on off, Mushfiqur defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.
Flighted on middle and leg, Mushfiqur defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Mushfiqur strokes it to the left of mid on. The fielder there dives and saves runs for his side.
Shorter off spinner. It pitches on off and spins in. Rahim turns it but finds short fine leg.
Length ball on the body of Sabbir, he plays it towards point.

FOUR! Sabbir is off the mark in style! It is slightly overpitched on middle, Sabbir picks it up early and flicks it between mid on and mid-wicket. The man at mid on puts in a dive to his right but cannot get close to the ball. The ball beats him and races onto the fence.
Again fullish and on off, this time Sabbir pushes it towards covers.
Good length ball on off, Sabbir plays it back to the bowler.

Peach of a delivery! Play and a miss! Good bowling by Nuwan. He pitches it on the fifth stump line on a length, it just nips away a bit. Sabbir plays inside the line of the delivery, but it misses the edge of the bat.
Length ball just outside off, Rahim guides it down to third man and gives the strike to Sabbir.
The new man in is Sabbir Rahman. It was this duo that showed fight in the last game they will have to do the same here, in fact they will have to do more than the last game.

OUT! TIMBER! Akila Dananjaya gets another. That is a lovely delivery. This one spins back in sharply. This is flatter and outside off, it pitches and spins back in. Mahmudullah goes back and looks to hit it through the off side but is done in by the turn. The ball hits the off pole. Bangladesh continue to slip further.
Another ball which is played to mid-wicket.
Very full and on middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Welcome boundary for Bangladesh. Rahim shuffles right across and Akila bowls it on the stumps. Rahim sweeps it fine on the leg side and the ball races away to the fence.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Misfield! Good length delivery outside off stump, Mushfiqur guides it to third man for a double.
A slower one on off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but is a touch early. It goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Mahmudullah misses out there! This is short and outside off, Mahmudullah throws his bat at it but misses.
Good length delivery on the pads, Mahmudullah tries to flick but gets hit on the pads. The batsman cross for a double.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off stump, Mahmudullah tries to cut it but gets beaten.
Good length delivery on off stump, Mahmudullah gets an edge back to the bowler. No run.
On off, Rahim defends it out.
On the fuller side on middle, Rahim works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, Rahim works it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on off, this is eased down to long on for one.
Good fielding! This is floated up on middle, Rahim works it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a half-stop. Can't stop the run.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back past the bowler and down to long on for one.
Good length delivery on off stump, Mushfiqur defends it to the off side and takes off for a run but is sent back by the non-striker.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks away to square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle stump, Mahmudullah blocks it back to the bowler.
This time a good length delivery on middle pole, Mahmudullah prods forwards and blocks it to cover.
BOUNCER! A good one at that. It was above the head of Mahmudullah who ducks under it.
Shortish in length outside off stump, Mahmudullah lets it go to the keeper.
Another off spinner on off, Rahim works it with the turn towards square leg. He wants a run but is sent back.
Mahmudullah is off the mark! This is slower through the air on off, Mahmudullah guides it towards point for one.
Straightaway uses his feet and works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Mahmudullah is the new man in. A slip and short leg in place for him.

Drinks Break! Sri Lanka once again on top here at Colombo. They have got three wickets and have Bangladesh on the back foot. Mushfiqur Rahim, once again will have to play a big knock here if the visitors are to reach a big total. Though for that to happen, someone will need to hang in there and support him.

OUT! Straight to the man! Dream start for Akila after returning into the side. The bowling change has worked brilliantly. A very soft dismissal this. Dananjaya floats this up on off, it is the off spinner. Mithun looks to work it with the turn but it comes slow off the surface. He ends up hitting it uppishly to Mendis at mid-wicket who accepts a dolly. Bangladesh continue to lose wickets at regular intervals.
This is on the pads, Rahim works it through square leg for one. 6000 ODI runs for Rahim. Only the third Bangladesh player to do so.
This is eased down to long on for one.
Akila Dananjaya is on now!
Keeps on bowling short over Rahim's head, he does not have a problem in ducking under it.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, Rahim lets it go back to the keeper.
Another short one on the body, Rahim hangs back and defends it back to the bowler.
Slower delivery outside off stump, Rahim leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, Mithun plays it to third man for a single. 50 up for the Tigers.
Shortish in length, Mithun tries to pull but gets an inside edge towards the off side.
Shorter and on middle, Mithun pulls it down to fine leg and takes one. Productive over for Bangladesh.
Rolls his fingers on this delivery and bowls it on middle, Mithun closes the face of the bat early and he gets a soft leading edge to point.
FOUR! Just over! There is a lot of width on offer outside off, Mithun goes after it. Does not bother to keep it down and just about clears the outstretched hand of point and then it races away.
On the shorter side, there is extra bounce on it. Rahim does well to get on  top of the bounce and play it over cover-point for one.
Quick run! This is fuller and on middle, Mithun works it to the right of mid on and takes one.
Shorter on off and angling away. Rahim guides it down to third man for one.
Short delivery on the body, Mushfiqur looked uncomfortable playing the pull and ends up getting an edge but the ball falls in no mans land. The batsman take a single.
Good length delivery on off pole, Rahim pushes it towards cover. No run.
Another short one and Rahim ducks under it.
Shorter in length and on middle, Mithun hops and nudges it around the corner for one.
Fuller this time on middle stump, Mithun drives it straight back to the bowler.
Short one from Kumara outside off stump, Rahim guides it to third man for a single.
Good length ball on the fourth stump line, Mushfiqur strokes it straight to point.
Fuller to Rahim on off, Mushfiqur nudges it to the right of mid off for one.
Now calmly taps  this length ball outside off to third man and gets a single.
Outside off on a length, Mithun leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball around off, Rahim plays a nicely timed pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Excellent effort in the field. Full on off, Musfiqur strokes it off the middle to the left of mid on. It looks like the ball will beat the fielder but Avishka Fernando at mid on dives to his left and saves a certain boundary. Saves 4 runs for his side.
Powerplay 2 time. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40 over.

A good short one to end! It is on the body, Mithun looks to pull but it goes off the underedge to the keeper. End of Powerplay 1. It started off well for Bangladesh but it will be Sri Lanka who will be the happier of the two. Bangladesh are 35 for 2 after it.
Almost plays it on! Shorter and outside off, Rahim hangs his bat out, gets an inside edge which goes close past the off pole and then towards the leg side for one.
On off and on a length, Rahim looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards the leg side.
Back of a length and on off, Rahim stands tall and keeps it out.
Goes short, probably the first bumper of the game. Mithun rocks back and pulls it towards deep backward square leg for one.
On off, Mithun defends it out.
On a length and around off, Rahim strokes it on the up to the man at cover-point.
Crisply driven! Fuller and on off, Mithun leans into it and strokes it to mid off for a quick run.
On off, this is defended solidly.
A leg bye! This is on the pads, Rahim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls on the leg side. A run is taken.
A good shot for no runs! A full ball on off, Rahim strokes it nicely but finds cover.
Mushfiqur Rahim replaces his skipper out in the middle. He will once again need to use all his experience and take his side out of trouble.

OUT! Drags it on! Both the openers are back in the hut now! Tamim Iqbal's poor run with the bat continues. He will be disappointed with the way he got out here. This is a nothing delivery. It is short and outside off. Tamim throws his bat at it away from the body. He only manages an inside edge which deflects back onto the stumps. Bangladesh in trouble now.
Slightly fuller and on middle, Mithun pushes it to mid on. A tight start by Kumara.
This is on the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
This is on middle and it angles away. Tamim looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. He gets a soft leading edge towards cover.
Excellent delivery! They are trying to get Tamim the way they did in the last game. A yorker on off, Tamim gets his bat down in time and jams it out.
Well played! This is on middle, Iqbal works it with soft hands through mid-wicket and takes two.
An ambitious appeal! This is a little too straight. Iqbal looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Lahiru Kumara is into the attack.
On off, this is blocked. Good 1st over by Udana, just 1 run off it.
Outside off, the batter lets it be.
Good length ball on off. Iqbal punches it towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Udana bowls it on a length just outside off, Iqbal lets it go.
On the pads of Iqbal, he plays it towards square leg.

Good ball by Udana to start off with. Iqbal tries to play this length ball but plays inside the line of the delivery. It just misses the outside edge of the bat. The keeper appeals loudly but it seems like he is the only one interested.
Just 3 overs for Dhananjaya de Silva to begin with. They have got a wicket inside Powerplay 1 so maybe the spinner has done the psychological damage.
Isuru Udana is on now!
Good length ball on middle and leg, Mithun plays it back towards mid on.
Ball pitched way outside off, Mithun lets it go through to the keeper.
Wide ball to start off to Mithun. On the leg side, Mithun tries to flick it but misses. Wide signalled.
Mohammad Mithun walks out at number 3.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb in front! Sarkar is dismissed off a full toss. He was probably beaten for pace there. Pradeep steams in from around the wicket and looks to bowl a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss. Sarkar looks to flick but is late in the shot. He misses and gets hit right in front. An appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Another failure for Sarkar. Pradeep draws first blood for the hosts.
On the pads of TI this time, he flicks it towards deep fine leg and the fielder cuts it off as the batters take three.
Guides this length ball towards the point fielder. No runs taken.
FOUR! Great shot by Tamim! Hit straight down the ground and with power. This was pitched full and on off, Iqbal takes one step forward and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Just the single from it! This is around middle, Iqbal pushes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
On off again, Iqbal once again defends it out. 5 dots in the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the stumps again, TI is solid in defense.
On the off pole, Iqbal defends it out.
Slower through the air on off, this is pushed to covers.
A couple to end! Back-to-back good overs for Bangladesh. This is on off, Sarkar pushes it towards cover-point. The fielder there dives over the ball which allows the batters to take two.
FOUR! Hits it on the up and finds the gap! Sarkar's first boundary. There is width on offer and it is on a length. Sarkar opens the face of the bat and guides it through cover-point for a boundary.
Around off, Sarkar drives it square on the off side but does not beat point.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg and a run is taken.
Slightly fuller and just outside off, Tamim shoulders arms to this one.
On off, this is defended.
A dot to end a good over for Bangladesh. This is floated up on off, Sarkar strokes it to mid off.
A couple now as Sarkar flicks it through mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on off, Sarkar defends it out.
Now follows the boundary with a single through square leg.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet for the first boundary! Tamim dances down the track and this time gets to the pitch of it. He hits it over mid on and it races away to the fence.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A dot to end another very good over by Iqbal. On off, this is blocked.

NOT OUT! The third umpire though quickly rules it in the favor of the batter. Right decision one would say in the end. Sri Lanka lose their only review very early. That is a top nut though by Pradeep. It is an inswinging yorker on middle. It shapes back in late. Tamim looks to jam it out but not sure whether he did so off the bat or was it boot. The Lankan players appeal but the umpire shakes his head as he feels it is bat. Sri Lanka review just in time. Replays roll in and it looks pretty close but the umpire decides it is bat first.

A huge shout for an LBW has been turned down and Sri Lanka review just in time. It seems to be bat first though. Looks very, very close initially. It seems to have hit bat and boot at the same time. The on-field call might just play a part here.
Good length and on off, Iqbal defends it out.
Good length ball just outside off, Iqbal plays it down towards mid off.
Sarkar guides this short of a length ball towards third man for a single.
Play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Nuwan gets it to shape a bit away from Sarkar. Sarkar chases the ball but misses.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Tamim uses his feet on the last ball but does not get to the pitch of it. He tries to defend but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket. End of a good first over by Dhananjaya.
Quicker and on off, Tamim defends it out.
Sarkar is off the mark now! This is on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Uppish but safe! Dhananjaya slows it up and lands it on off, Sarkar goes hard at it. It goes uppishly but well short of covers.
Fires this on the off pole, Sarkar defends it out.

Bangladesh are underway straightaway! A risky run though. This is floated up on off, Tamim pushes it towards cover and takes off. The non-striker does hesitate for a second but the fielder fails to pick the ball up and an easy single in the end.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Sri Lankan players make their way out to the middle. The Bangladesh openers, Soumya Sarkar and Tamim Iqbal follow them. Dhananjaya de Silva, a spinner, to start the proceedings with the first new ball. Maybe because there are two left-handers out there. A slip in place. Here we go...

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Kusal Perera (WK), Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Lahiru Thirimanne, Dhananjaya de Silva, Akila Dananjaya (IN FOR THISARA PERERA), Isuru Udana (IN FOR LASITH MALINGA), Nuwan Pradeep, Lahiru Kumara.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Soumya Sarkar, Mohammad Mithun, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Sabbir Rahman, Mosaddek Hossain, Mehedi Hasan, Shafiul Islam, Taijul Islam (IN FOR RUBEL HOSSAIN), Mustafizur Rahman.

Sri Lankan skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne, says they wanted to bat too. Informs they have two changes. States after Malinga, they need to look for wicket takers and hence, they have chosen Isuru, Lahiru and Pradeep bowled well in the last game and they hope they can do it again here. Ends by saying he is expecting good batting from his side as there are a few players who have found form.

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal, says it looks a nice wicket and there is something for the bowlers under lights, there was some turn in the last game and hence they have played a spinner and rested a pacer. States they have to start well whether they are batting or bowling and they need to set the tone. Ends by saying Malinga not being there gives them a lot of confidence but they are still a quality side.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Bangladesh. THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

Hello and welcome to the 2nd game of this 3-match ODI series between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The hosts will look to start a new chapter with a win after the retirement of their star bowler, Lasith Malinga. Sri Lanka were completely dominant in the last game and outplayed Bangladesh in all the departments. The visitors, on the other hand, will look to improve their performance and put up a better show with both, bat and ball and will have to fight to survive in the series. A crucial clash awaits us at Colombo. Can Bangladesh survive or will Sri Lanka wrap up the series? Stay tuned to find out as the toss is not far away.
